fifo_trigger_leaf_review.decoded_behavior: Read FIFO_CONFIG, derive depth 16 when (config&0xc000)==0 else 8, BKPT#1 if level>=depth; otherwise read RX_FIFO_CTRL, replace low byte with level, write back, preserving upper 24 bits.
fifo_trigger_leaf_review.invalid_behavior: Intentional API divergence: stock original BKPTs and raises emulator exception; reconstructed checked API returns INVALID_LEVEL. Invalid original traces read only config and do not write the control register.
limits: No electrical bus trace or measured IRQ/trigger firing behavior.
